scope: Burnout (dry) 1,100 t budget only; reaction mass and fusion fuel are OPEN. Positions are local placement rules for owner review (15_MODEL_INTERFACES S1); spec and rig keep centre of mass and inertia unknown.

main_structure: rotating 25 t volume-uniform over the inner and outer hoops of both ring frames; spokes, hubs, bearings and locks are not separated (OD-016)
stationary 125 t on the primary-cage shell
forward_impact_shielding: forward shield disc (r 45 m, area-uniform samples at the skin mid-plane); the 100 t Brow mass is PROVISIONAL and not validated for 90 m
habitat_pressure_structure: volume-uniform over the six pressurized sector envelopes
eye_sensors: four facet modules, module depth aft of each well floor on the well axes (r 4.0 m)
life_support_garden_medical: volume-uniform over the six occupied sectors (12!A4,A6)
water_radiation_shielding: rotating, volume-uniform over the frame fills between the sectors (12!A13; 13!A7 keeps all 180 t rotating); the refuge shell is not placed separately (P1B-011)
workshop_spares_cargo: midship service volume between the STORAGE station and the radiator front (aft of the rings), r 3 m
drive_package: uniform from the nozzle exits to the core front
radiators_thermal: uniform over the three blade planforms (upper bound; exchangers and buffers sit inboard)
food_consumables: stationary stores around the refuge (usable as refuge shielding)

refuge_shield.note: Outer cylinder plus end annuli at water density; the spine side is left open. 13_MASS_POSITIONS assigns all 180 t of water to the rotating ring frames, and the stationary budget holds only 10 t food/consumables and 60 t workshop/spares/cargo.

observations: Dry COM sits about 17.6 m forward of the body midpoint (range 15.1-20.2 m with the drive package at the nozzles or the core); the thrust line passes through it only because the layout is axisymmetric.
Largest pitch-inertia shares: drive_package 43%, forward_impact_shielding 12%, water_radiation_shielding 12%, main_structure 8%.
Where the propellant tanks go (unsourced) will move the departure COM more than any dry-mass placement choice.
